note: SEED, not an allowlist. A vendor missing from here is discovered at resolution time, verified by actually parsing what discovery returns, and remembered in the cache directory's _learned.json - so ordering from somewhere new needs no change here. This file is for entries worth hand-holding: a chain with a swap group (which cannot be discovered), or one where discovery picks the wrong page. Nothing here is trusted because it is listed; every source still has to parse consistently to earn label confidence.
how_to_add: Usually unnecessary - just order and let discovery run. Add an entry by hand when a chain needs a swap group, or when _learned.json shows a `failed` record whose tried_url is actually the right page in a format the parser does not read yet.

wagamama.notes: Linked from wagamama.com/allergen-information. The chain's own menu pages are JavaScript-rendered and yield nothing to a fetch. Northern Ireland has a separate matrix (…allergymatrix03) not wired here.

swap_groups.note: A rice bowl arrives with plain white rice (Jamie, 10 Aug 2026 - he is the authority on what is in the bowl, not the menu's wording). Ordering brown instead is a SWAP, so the honest adjustment is the difference between those two published rows: -30 kcal and +4.5 g fibre. Nothing in the order line marks it as a change, which is why it needs naming here - 'with brown rice' reads like part of the dish.
